message.content: {"caption":"A four-panel chart figure comparing Memento with baselines and memory variants across benchmark accuracy, learning iterations, and out-of-distribution tasks.","description":"The target is a four-panel figure of bar and line charts. (a) A grouped bar chart plots Accuracy (%) from 0.0 to 1.0 for Val-Level1, Val-Level2, Val-Level3, Test-Level1, Test-Level2, and Test-Level3. Its legend lists Memento, manus.ai, AWorld, OpenAI DR, and OWL++. Printed bar values are shown in chart_values. Memento is highest in each category; its values are 0.96, 0.91, 0.58 on validation and 0.85, 0.65, 0.59 on test. The other bars appear only where shown. (b) A grouped bar chart plots Accuracy (%) from 0 to 100 for DeepResearcher, SimpleQA, and HLE, with series Memento, Memento w/o CBR, Online Executor, and Offline Executor. All printed values are in chart_values. Memento leads each benchmark; SimpleQA is highest overall, while all four HLE values are much lower. (c) A line chart plots Accuracy (%) against Iteration 1–5 for Memento w/o CBR, Memento w/ Non-Parametric CBR, and Memento w/ Parametric CBR. Point values are estimated from the plotted marks because they are not printed. All three series rise across iterations; the parametric CBR line is highest, non-parametric CBR is next, and no CBR is lowest throughout. (d) A grouped bar chart compares Memento w/o CBR (darker bars) with Memento (lighter bars) on Musique F1, Musique PM, Bamboogle F1, Bamboogle PM, PopQA F1, and PopQA PM. Bar heights are estimated from the 0–100 Accuracy (%) axis. Each pair has an upward, right-pointing arrow toward the taller Memento bar, annotated respectively +4.7, +8.0, +7.0, +9.6, +5.3, and +5.5; these printed annotations indicate gains. Memento is higher in all six categories, with the largest labeled gain on Bamboogle
